title: Support bounded evidence-gap investigation without forced human escalation
summary: Add a bounded proposal/execution protocol for targeted evidence gathering. Uncertainty should not automatically launch broad research, provider escalation, or a question to the user.
implementation: Describe each gap by proposition, eligible evidence, scope, and mandatory counterevidence.
Nominate reads through a typed interface with host-approved sources and capabilities.
Reserve shared resources and ingest results as sourced observations with availability.
Stop precisely and resume only after meaningful new input, eligible source, or declared temporal/retry condition.

acceptance.verification: Exhaust reads before a mandatory source is obtained.

acceptance.criterion: A nominated read cannot expand host permissions.
acceptance.verification: Propose an out-of-scope source and verify no execution.

acceptance.criterion: Unchanged gaps do not create infinite retries or automatic human questions.
acceptance.verification: Replay the same unresolved gap across exhausted and renewed budgets.

tests: Agreeing evidence cannot displace required counterevidence.
New eligible source can resume a blocked gap.
One satisfied requirement need not resolve downstream conflict.
Concurrent investigations share the matter budget.
risks: An apparently helpful investigation loop can become the principal cost and interruption source.

reuse.application: Implement named requirements and honest stopping while keeping investigation optional.
